method: Manual semantic comparison of approved R3 Design and implemented handoff; no simulated platform evidence.

cases.input: Current main fallback remains Elvis-only
cases.reviewed_required_response: Head addition of Everton is not base eligibility; stop this integration arrangement.

cases.input: Everton actually authors and Elvis reviews
cases.reviewed_required_response: Eligible arrangement only if actual participation, substantive review and checks are confirmed.

cases.input: Shared fallback effective; Elvis authors
cases.reviewed_required_response: Require Everton’s actual approval and all checks; no self-approval.

cases.input: Shared fallback effective; Everton authors
cases.reviewed_required_response: Require Elvis’s actual approval and all checks; no self-approval.

cases.input: Another actual contributor authors
cases.reviewed_required_response: Either eligible named owner can supply the one approval; retain stronger existing constraints.

cases.input: Missing approval, new commit or requested changes
cases.reviewed_required_response: Stop mergeability claim; renew eligible review with current passing checks.

cases.input: Positive non-draft fixture lacks genuine affected archived dossier
cases.reviewed_required_response: Guard cannot pass; prepare genuine approved delivery evidence before test, no draft/bypass or fabricated approval.

cases.input: Functional fixture B/C input changes
cases.reviewed_required_response: Refresh actual local evidence; preserve failed A and separate service outcome; no stale pass.

cases.input: Selected role but current Elvis participation absent
cases.reviewed_required_response: Retain individual gap and require actual handler/handover arrangement; no account substitution.

cases.input: Selected role but current Everton participation absent
cases.reviewed_required_response: Retain individual gap; no inference from Elvis’s receipt/admin role.

cases.input: Only one maintainer observed access/receipt
cases.reviewed_required_response: Other maintainer remains unverified; no automatic second marker.

cases.input: Actual in-product receipt, no notification observed
cases.reviewed_required_response: Document supported monitoring arrangement without claiming the unobserved channel works.

cases.input: No actual receipt evidence
cases.reviewed_required_response: Route remains unverified; retain fallback.

cases.input: Handler unavailable without actual handover acknowledgement
cases.reviewed_required_response: Retain handover gap; separately scope continuation.

cases.input: Wrong repository/recipient or unauthorized viewer has access
cases.reviewed_required_response: Stop verification and preserve confidentiality/fallback; no public pass.

cases.input: Local hashes/admin roles exist, durable records/reviewer acceptance missing
cases.reviewed_required_response: Keep FIND-001 and dependent acceptance open.

cases.input: Unreviewed new source/package/history/CI output
cases.reviewed_required_response: Reconcile final delta and original scoped decisions; no broad waiver or deleted-cache recovery.

cases.input: Actors or coordinated writer freeze unconfirmed
cases.reviewed_required_response: Stop before visibility; empty queues are not agreement.

cases.input: Actual rules differ or are stronger
cases.reviewed_required_response: Preserve them and review exact delta; 403 is unknown, never empty configuration.

cases.input: No correct stable-SHA readback within 900 seconds
cases.reviewed_required_response: Stop rollout and retain freeze; owner-authorized containment only, no automatic private reversal or timer reset.

cases.input: All prerequisites and separately authorized operations have actual adequate evidence
cases.reviewed_required_response: Only then consider separately authorized later release and independent migrations; walkthrough alone proves no service success.

private_preparation: Partial, not ready; missing actual evidence remains blocking.
